What is this

A master string is the compact, copy-pasteable form of a scramble key, e.g. WTV1-1337-9-HIP: WTV<version>-<seed>-<grid>-<flags>, where flags is any combination of H (flip horizontal), V (flip vertical), I (invert colors), P (block permute) — in that order — or 0 for none enabled.

This page needs no web server and makes no network requests. It reimplements the exact same math used by the OBS plugin and the viewer userscript — mulberry32, the Fisher–Yates permutation builder, tile geometry, flip/invert, and encode/parse for the master string — copied verbatim into a plain script tag so it also runs unmodified from a file:// URL.

A matching key is exactly what a viewer pastes into the wtv-descramble.user.js userscript's panel: the broadcaster picks a key in OBS, shares the master string with their audience out-of-band, and only viewers with that exact string see an undistorted picture.

  • Scramble pipeline order: flip → invert → block-permute (using inv).
  • Descramble pipeline order (inverse): un-permute (using perm) → invert → flip.
  • The green/red banner below the canvases does an exact pixel compare of Original vs Descrambled — for any valid key this should always be a bit-exact match, since the round trip is guaranteed by the contract.
master-key-preview.html — standalone verifier, implements the wtv-descramble contract v1 (same math as the OBS plugin and viewer userscript).
